name: Enterprise Router Policy
description: Baseline security and operational compliance policy for enterprise Cisco routers.

rules.name: Telnet Disabled
rules.description: Telnet must not be permitted as a transport input on VTY lines

rules.name: NTP Configured
rules.description: Device should synchronize time with an NTP server

rules.name: Logging Enabled
rules.description: Device should send logs to a logging/syslog host

rules.name: AAA Enabled
rules.description: AAA new-model must be enabled for centralized authentication

rules.name: SNMP Configured
rules.description: SNMP community/server should be configured for monitoring
